Messages.Author: Potato
Messages.Body:
Crimson Fury
Cardtype: Reaction/Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Animalism
This card can be played as a reaction card or a combat card. Only
usable when this vampire is being diablerized. Usable by a tapped
vampire. Usable by a vampire in torpor.
[ani] The diablerie is canceled and the diablerist burns 1 blood.
[ANI] Burn both the diablerist and this vampire. (The diablerie is
still considered successful.)

Say my vampire is taking the Regeneration action. She gets blocked,
and the blocker choose to diablerize. Assuming my vampire has
appropriate animalism, would I be right in thinking that she would
still not be able to play Crimson Fury? My thoughts here are that it
this not a combat situation, and it is also my turn - ruling out the
reaction.

Cheers in advance
Chris
